messages:
ana: Quick sync on the compact inspector for the rollout timeline. Pushed a tiny Figma frame. Main question: hover preview vs persistent open for keyboard users?

mike: The compact pills look good. Hover reveals details but we need equivalence for keyboard/screen readers.

sam: Tech note: we can do CSS hover preview and JS-driven persistent inspector on Enter/click. Use aria-expanded on the inspector container.

yvonne: Accessibility: don't rely on hover-only tooltips. Add aria-describedby to point to a hidden region with the pill details. Also micro-pill contrast is low (3.2:1). Need 4.5:1 for normal text.

ana: Proposal: Tab lands on node, Enter opens inspector (persistent). Arrow keys navigate pills inside. Hover can show a transient preview for mouse.

mike: Can we keep a quick hover peek for mouse without opening the dialog? Users like quick glances.

sam: Yes 12:hover preview as CSS with opacity/transform; persistent inspector is role=dialog and controlled by JS. Preview must not steal focus.

yvonne: If inspector uses role=dialog, manage focus trapping only if it's modal. This inspector is contextual so don't set aria-modal. Ensure focus returns on close.

mike: Copy tweak: change "canary: 5%" to "Canary   5% traffic"? (typo) Wait. Better: "Canary  5% traffic". Actually, suggested copy: "Canary  5% traffic".

ana: Let's make it explicit: "Canary  5% traffic". Also add sr-only text: "Canary variant, receiving 5 percent of traffic".

yvonne: For touch, remove hover previews; rely on tap to open inspector. Document that behavior.

sam: CSS for preview (small):

.rollout-node .preview {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .12s ease, transform .12s ease;
}
.rollout-node:hover .preview { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

sam: For keyboard use :focus-within to show preview only when node is focused.

mike: UX question: show "Undo" inline or only in expanded history? My vote: inline low-prominence Undo icon that opens a confirmation modal.

ana: Agreed. Checklist for engineers I'll add to the frame: 1) hover preview CSS + 200ms hide delay, 2) Enter opens persistent inspector (role=dialog), 3) arrow nav inside inspector, 4) sr-only descriptions for pills, 5) confirmation modal semantics for rollback, 6) update microcopy to "Canary  5% traffic", 7) adjust contrast and padding.

deploy-bot: FYI: staging deploy with rollout-inspector toggles tomorrow 1500UTC. :rocket:

mike: Can close once PR references the checklist. :thumbsup:
